There are many steps you can take to reduce the risk of being arrested or fined for conducting an unauthorized gathering or activity. 
First, do some research and create a detailed plan that includes possible legal defense arguments for any charges that may be brought against you. Ensure all participants understand the risks of attending and provide them with clear instructions on what to do if they get stopped by authorities.
Secondly, try reaching out to the local police station beforehand and explain your plans, so they are aware of what is happening.
Finally, make sure to document everything before, during and after your event. Get photographs or video from multiple angles if possible, as well as writings down details like attendants’ names and any conversations with police officers that took place. If needed use pseudonyms instead of real names.
By following these steps, you can better minimize any risks while still making your protest counted!
